meta.description:
Vietnam vlog from Chennai to Hanoi | Solo Budget Travel Series 🇻🇳 | Hanoi | Northern vietnam | Episode 1 

In this vlog, I start my 3rd Country Vietnam solo budget travel journey from Chennai to Hanoi.

✈️ Route:
Chennai → Bangkok (Airasia)
Bangkok → Hanoi (AirAsia)

I share my transit experience in Bangkok airport, including charging facilities available during the layover. I also talked about my AirAsia flight experience on the way to Hanoi.

After landing in Hanoi:
* Bought a Viettel SIM card at the airport (good coverage & data speed)
* Withdrawn Vietnamese Dong (VND) from Vietcombank ATM
* Tried the local express Bus 86 from airport to the city
* Got down at Ly Nam De stop
* Took a Grab bike to reach Urban Slumber Hostel
* Lunch at the hostel after the journey
* Currency comparison explained VND vs INR

While entering the city, you can see the famous Red River of Vietnam, local neighborhoods, and traditional Vietnamese houses which give the first feel of "The Capital Hanoi".

🌤 Weather:
January in Hanoi is chill and pleasant, perfect for walking around the city. Jerkin/Hoodie Must.
In the evening, I explore the beautiful Hoan Kiem Lake area and experience the night atmosphere of Hanoi. It will be coming soon..

This travel series will cover:
* Budget travel in Vietnam
* Public transport experience
* Hostels & local food
* Hidden and less explored places all over North-Central-South Vietnam❤️

📍 Travel Notes:
Airport → City: Direct Bus 86
Ly Nam De stop → Grab bike to hostel
SIM card: Viettel
Cash: Vietcombank ATM

Brother please watch my final vlog of vietnam travel, I shared everything about budget❤

Because vietnam is huge the start and ending point is important. We can tell anything based on that.. for 3 nights if you plan to explore hanoi city side alone it's so cheap. If you plan hanoi+nearby places like tam coc/non binh/halong bay it definitely differs. That's why i am saying. Nowadays flight costs are expensive so plan your trip and book the flights long before. If you are booking the flight instant, it's expensive. That's why I am saying. Plan accordingly.
